remarks_1999: O'Keeffe wrote: "...this belonged to Frank Lloyd Wright.! tried to buy it back when he died and they would not sell" (from the notebook O'Keeffe kept of the 1970 Whitney exhibition; owned by Georgia O'Keeffe Papers, The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (Now housed at the Georgia O'Keeffe Museum)). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Pelvis With Shadows and the Moon

description: The complex, rippling forms of an animal's pelvis bones cast bright blue shadows over a semiabstract landscape. A black mesa runs along the bottom of the work below stripes of yellow, pink, and white. Blue sky fills the upper half of the composition's background. In the top right corner, a white moon glows over a blue silhouette of Pedernal.
